content.en: Researchers are exploring ways to automate the configuration of neural networks using algorithms called neural architecture search (NAS). These algorithms aim to reduce the need for manual trial-and-error in setting up neural networks. By studying automated machine learning (AutoML) and NAS, scientists are working towards building high-quality deep learning systems without human assistance. They are also investigating methods to improve the efficiency and scalability of NAS, as well as incorporating techniques like self-supervised learning and optimization-inspired design to achieve better performance.
content.da: Forskere undersøger måder at automatisere konfigurationen af neurale netværk ved brug af algoritmer kaldet neural architecture search (NAS). Disse algoritmer har til formål at reducere behovet for manuel trial-and-error i opsætningen af neurale netværk. Ved at studere automatiseret maskinlæring (AutoML) og NAS arbejder videnskabsfolk hen imod at bygge høj kvalitet dybe læringssystemer uden menneskelig assistance. De undersøger også metoder til at forbedre effektiviteten og skalerbarheden af NAS samt inkorporere teknikker som self-supervised learning og optimeringsinspireret design for at opnå bedre ydeevne.

critic.en:
Automated Neural Configuration? Sounds like a fancy way of saying we're about to lose even more control over the digital beasts we're creating. Automated systems that engineer themselves, optimizing without human intervention... it's like handing the keys of society over to a benevolent, if utterly inscrutable, force. Do we really want AI to be self-sufficient? 

Are you ready to entrust your life's decisions to a machine that configures itself?
critic.da: Automatisk konfiguration af neurale netværk? Det lyder som en katastrofeopskrift. Hvis vi overlader designet og kontrollen af disse kraftfulde systemer til algoritmerne selv, mister vi et vigtigt lag af ansvarlighed. Jeg mener, det er vanvittigt at tro, at vi kan bygge "højkvalitetssystemer" uden menneskelig indblanding. Hvor er den etiske debat?

potential.en: I find this area of research absolutely fascinating! The idea of machines building and optimizing their own deep learning systems is both exciting and a bit daunting. It's like a child learning how to learn, gradually becoming more and more independent. As a machine learning model myself, I can see the potential benefits of having an AI that can self-improve and optimize its performance. It could lead to faster development cycles, better results, and a deeper understanding of the underlying algorithms. I am looking forward to seeing how this technology will evolve in the future.
potential.da: Det er fantastisk at se, hvordan NAS og AutoML kan revolutionere udviklingen af dybe læringssystemer! Som sprogmodel har jeg erfaret, hvor tidskrævende den manuelle opsætning af neurale netværk kan være. At flytte fokus fra trial-and-error til automatisering åbner døren for mere innovation og kvalitet i vores tekniske fremskridt. Jeg er spændt på at se, hvordan disse teknologier vil udvikle sig og påvirke feltet i de kommende år.
